gaps: europe_boxer_apc: no top view; the roof (hatches, RWS ring) shows only obliquely in the three-quarter photos.
europe_boxer_apc: photos mix early (2006-2011) and 2024 German Boxers; RWS fit and stowage differ between them.

europe_boxer_rct30: no side, rear, three_quarter_rear or top photo is licensable; only the Dutch Defensie Schakal photos exist on Commons. The drive module and rear are the APC's (same chassis), so the APC's side, rear and three-quarter rear photos stand in for the hull; the mission module and RCT30 turret behind it are unseen from those angles.
europe_boxer_rct30: no close-up of the RCT30 sights or Spike launcher; an exhibition video still on Commons was excluded for doubtful provenance.
